items.title: 16.2 Common types of hazards in a laboratory (lab ke aam khatre) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.2, printed page 337.

blocks.text: Lab mein kaam karte hue jin hazards (khatron) ka saamna ho sakta hai, un mein se zyada tar teen types (qismon) mein aate hain: physical, chemical aur biological hazards. Har type agle teen topics mein hai.

blocks.caption: Teen types
rows: geele farsh par phisalna aur girna; toote sheeshe se kat jana
har chemical ke apne khatre; standard procedure se istemal
allergens; janwaron se insanon ko lagne wali infectious bimariyan; viral bimariyan

blocks.prompt: In cheezon ko teen types mein rakhein: toota hua beaker, concentrated acid ki botal, mould (phaphoondi) ki culture.
blocks.explanation: Toota beaker physical hazard hai (kat lagna); concentrated acid chemical hazard hai (jalna, dhuan); mould culture biological hazard hai (allergy, infection).

items: Lab ke hazards teen type ke hain: physical, chemical aur biological.
